methodology.cache_size: right-sized per (precision,context) from analytical KV x margin (NOT the production cache_size=3)
methodology.warmup: one untimed generate at the FULL context length before timing
methodology.thermal: fanless Arc 140V throttles under sustained long-context prefill; combos are cooldown-separated so each starts from a comparable baseline, and per-rep TTFT (ttft_ms_first = cool start vs the median = sustained) is retained

memory_instruments.analytical_kv_gib: ground truth from geometry x precision bytes (the true precision lever)
memory_instruments.gpu_mem_kv_pool_gib: GPU_MEMORY_STATISTICS cl_mem — the reserved KV pool (tracks cache_size)
memory_instruments.gpu_mem_host_gib: GPU_MEMORY_STATISTICS usm_host — model weights + working buffers
memory_instruments.sys_peak_used_gib: system-RAM proxy (shared-LPDDR5X iGPU); coarse whole-footprint check
memory_instruments.note: usm_device stays ~0 on this iGPU; the KV pool is pre-reserved to cache_size, so the precision lever is read from analytical_kv_gib, not the reserved-pool size
